theme: EA time-stamped point-cloud and independent ground-truth quality controls
verified_controls: time-stamped point cloud contains 3D x y z points and attributes
DTM and DSM time-stamped rasters are derived from point-cloud data
historic raster does not always have a matching archived point cloud
point cloud includes ground and surface-object classification
point-cloud archive is available for surveys going back to 2006
site-specific lidar surveys across England go back to 1998
DTM time-stamped tiles are available at 25cm 50cm 1m and 2m resolutions
DTM elevation is referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
time-stamped lidar vertical accuracy is plus or minus 15cm RMSE
ground-truth point accuracy is plus or minus 3cm RMSE
ground-truth sites use flat unambiguous surfaces
ground truth may be reused only within stated age limits including stricter coastal limit
lidar QC requires less than plus or minus 15cm RMSE
lidar QC also constrains standard deviation and random error
no parcel measurement is promoted when survey lineage or epoch compatibility is unresolved
